messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: QBR: pipeline review + forecast consolidation

Team —

We're two weeks out from the QBR and I need a consolidated view for leadership (finance + GTM) by EOD Fri 2/27. Concrete asks below so we can build the deck Monday: 

1) Sales pipeline export for your regions (stage, ARR, close probability, committed date). Use the attached QBR_pipeline_template.xlsx.
2) Account-by-account one-pagers for top 12 accounts (logo, ARR, health, recent exec engagement, key risks/opps). Use Account_summary_template.docx.
3) A short forecast note (upsides & downsides) to appear on the top-line forecast slide.

Please: mark any deals that need pre-QBR exec attention with the tag "QBR_ESCALATE" in the spreadsheet and flag any asks (credits, SLA exceptions, pricing concessions) in the email thread. Marcus — can you pull the HubSpot report and drop the export into the Drive folder linked below?

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR-2026/overview

I'll consolidate and circulate an initial forecast. If you foresee blockers to the Friday EOD deadline, call me today.

Thanks —
Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Strategy & Operations
Redwood Inference

To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR: pipeline review + forecast consolidation

Laura —

Attached: Rishi_pipeline_ACME+BetaCo.xlsx (filtered export + notes). Highlights below.

- ACME Analytics (Sophie Grant): $420k ARR, open for a POC expansion to embeddings. Probability 60%, target close 2026-03-18; risk: procurement timelines and SOC2 evidence requested (we shipped SOC2 docs last quarter, shared again).
- BetaCo: $1.1M ARR, multi-product deal; legal is asking for a 12mo SLA carveout — flagged as QBR_ESCALATE.
- Two smaller logo inserts (WestStart & NovaTech) likely to close in March but low ACV.

Notes: I used the template and added a short "executive ask" column for each account. Help needed on BetaCo SLA (legal + contracts).

Laura / team —

I uploaded 6 account one-pagers to the Drive under /Account_Pages/ (GlobalRetail, NorthStream, OrbitIQ, Polaris, Satori, Helix). Key flags: 

- GlobalRetail (Victor Holtz): $2.3M ARR, renewal in May. Their exec sponsor has been less responsive; procurement asked for a custom data-retention clause. I'm recommending a 30-day extension to close but we should plan an executive outreach if we can't get signature by 3/15.
- Polaris: healthy — upsell motion to go after embeddings for search; high probability but smaller ACV.
- Satori and Helix: evidence requests were handled last quarter; marked green.

Attachment references: Account_summary_template.docx used for all one-pagers. I also noted a potential credit ask from GlobalRetail — tagging that for finance and legal review.

On procurement/contract asks: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marcus — can you confirm whether the HubSpot export includes the "legal_review_required" boolean? If not, I will prepare a manual list.

Thanks,

Thanks for the fast turn. I've pulled the attachments and started consolidation — attached is consolidated_forecast_v1.csv. High-level summary for the QBR slide: 

- Forecasted ARR (base case): $5.4M for the quarter.
- Upside (stretch): +$1.2M (mainly BetaCo and ACME expansions).
- Downside risks: GlobalRetail procurement delay (-$2.3M) and BetaCo SLA negotiation (timing risk).

Immediate asks: 
- Legal: please triage BetaCo SLA (marked QBR_ESCALATE) — can you provide your earliest ETA on redline?
- Finance: review potential credit ask from GlobalRetail and advise on acceptable parameters (up to 10% credit recommended only if exec outreach fails).
- Marcus: confirm HubSpot export in the Drive includes the "legal_review_required" flag and update if missing.

I'll finalize the deck Monday morning and share a dry-run invite for Tue 3/2 10:00 AM PT. If anyone sees errors in the consolidated forecast, reply here with corrections and attach updated csv.

Attachments: consolidated_forecast_v1.csv

Laura
VP, Sales Strategy & Operations
Redwood Inference
